claim: The overlap-restricted span of source-valid P/PN chart ports has actual native higher witnessing packages retaining both full reference packets and PN law-domain certificates, with composition on triple common domains and explicit handling of empty intersections, without extending to lost ports or identifying incompatible roles.
source_policy: Literal complete validated port-input records for every independently generated chart/eligible-face pair, including the base chart, actual selected source/target packets, five references, permutation, PN operation and optional reader history. The policy is fixed before choosing a pair, triple or common face. No span/composition result is seeded.
constructor: Native P retains both port records over a common face and both role-indexed permit proofs. Native P over the common-domain type forms the span; E selects a certified common index. Triple packages retain AB, BC, AC and the full three-port source record. The exact same middle certificate is reused on the declared triple domain.
composition_boundary: Composition is on a shared face with all three permits and a common middle source, not on arbitrary pairwise nonempty overlaps. Preserve all route histories, and compare the explicitly declared seam/end observations without asserting equality of different whole packages.
empty_control: Use both disjoint PN domains and three charts with pairwise nonempty domains but empty triple intersection. Native P may construct the empty family; no E selection or triple composition may be fabricated there.
formal_scope: Prove generic actual P/E constructors, retention equations, middle-seam equality and common-face endpoint laws under the explicit full-port input policy. Instantiate with actual-source quoted port records and finite role predicates. Source PN geometry/validation remains runtime bound, not kernel interpretation of JavaScript.
boundary: Higher WG witnessed partial span only. No total PN gauge transformation, physical role-changing path, simultaneous occupied assembly, full four-face descent, whole-space identification or forcing is implied.
stop_condition: Return only the native partial-span/composition result at its declared policy, or the first missing admission/seam cell. Keep lost-port and empty-domain controls mandatory.
